description: Provision and drive a `pu` box — an Incus container used as a clean Linux host for CI, builds, and evidence capture. Use when you need to run something on a fresh remote box instead of the user's machine: `nix run` a build, run CI against a real host, capture screenshots/video off-machine, or reproduce on a pristine environment. Covers create/connect/scp/destroy, running remote commands, copying artifacts back, and the no-egress failure mode. Triggers on "pu box", "spin up a box", "run this on a box", "ephemeral host", "pu create/connect/destroy".
